name: Ravenscar Home Care
description: Home care agency visiting older people in the fictional district of Ravenscar.

items.title: Care visit prices
items.content: A 30-minute visit costs $26.80 and an hour $46.20. Price list RHC-PRC-30.

items.title: Service area
items.content: We cover 17 villages around Ravenscar, from Thornwick to Saltby. Map RHC-MAP-17.

items.title: Carer travel rules
items.content: Carers get 31 pence per mile and 10 minutes travel time between visits; mileage is approved by Dorota Wiśniewska. Rules RHC-TRV-31.

items.title: Key safe procedure
items.content: Key safe codes are stored in app RHC-KEY-4 and never written down; codes change every 4 months.

items.title: Missed visit death
items.content: A client, Albert Fenn, was found on the floor on 2026-10-05 after 2 visits were missed; he died in hospital. The council safeguarding team is investigating. Report RHC-INC-1005-F.

items.title: Council contract renewal
items.content: Ravenscar Council will pay $23.10 an hour from 2027-04-01, below our cost of $24.75; we may hand back 140 clients. Note RHC-CNL-0401-R.
